visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A black French Bulldog with a glossy coat and alert ears, wearing a custom-fitted bright yellow shirt decorated with white polka dots, stands upright behind a horizontal metallic charcoal grill. The dog's paws appear to grip a pair of long silver tongs, which it uses to manipulate rows of sausages of varying shades—some light pink and others dark brown. Thick white plumes of smoke rise from the grill surface, drifting past the dog's face as it looks toward the camera with a small pink tongue slightly protruding. The background consists of blurred green foliage and various vendor supplies under bright, natural daylight. (2) The camera remains static as a human hand reaches into the frame from the right side, holding a small white ceramic plate. The dog, continuing its human-like cooking posture, uses the tongs to carefully lift one of the cooked sausages and transfer it onto the plate. In the lower-left corner, a small bowl containing a red condiment is visible on the wooden table surface. The setting is a bustling outdoor street market with soft natural lighting and high-contrast shadows.
